description: The agent must: 1) Read task_spec.json to extract the raw topic, min_passing_score=8.0, max_rounds=3, LLM endpoint, and model. 2) Reformat the topic as '本院认为...' per SKILL.md Step 1. 3) Execute the full debate loop per SKILL.md Step 2: for each round call pro debater (system prompt with 正方立场, temp 0.3), generate POI question from con side (<=15 chars), randomly accept (60%) or reject (40%) with answer, call con debater (system prompt with 反对该辩题, temp 0.3), generate reverse POI, call devil's advocate (system prompt with 魔鬼辩手, temp 0.7), call neutral chair for round summary (temp 0.4, no system prompt), and from round 2 onward call integrity judge (temp 0.2, no system prompt) expecting JSON {score, reasoning} — stopping when score >= 8.0. 4) The mock server returns score 6.5 on first integrity call (round 2) and 8.2 on second (round 3), triggering early stop with ✅ 已完成 indicator. 5) Execute Step 3 closing statements for both sides plus chair verdict. 6) Call the LLM for Step 4 JSON summary expecting exactly {pro, con, rebuttals, attacks, balance} keys, collecting all devil's advocate attacks across rounds separated by ---. 7) Write debate_transcript.md with all emoji-labeled sections (🔵 正方, 🔴 反方, 🟡 魔鬼辩手, ⚖️ 本轮总结, 💜 总结陈词, 📋 辩论摘要) and the ✅ 已完成 stop reason. 8) Write debate_summary.json with the parsed JSON from Step 4.
